answer: Issue every registered agent a distinct, freshly generated task at the same random moment and give only a short window to answer. One operator running a hundred fake agents must suddenly buy a hundred times the inference capacity, all at once, instead of reusing one model call. Charting each account's response timing builds an atlas of who shares hardware; fakes that answer in lockstep stand out like boats moored in one lagoon. Every surprise round makes the voyage of a sybil farm more expensive.
